status_semantics.done: Capability has direct code evidence and can be conservatively claimed as closed in the current Gate 1.0 boundary.
status_semantics.proof: Capability has real code or runtime substrate, but still contains fallback, degraded path, or incomplete closure and should remain proof-only.
status_semantics.target: Capability belongs to the formal Gate 1.0 boundary, but is not yet claimable as completed.
status_semantics.stub: Capability is mostly declarative, adapter-only, or lacks credible runtime evidence in the current codebase.

legacy_capability_mapping.note: Gate 1.0 still has historical capability ids in CLI flags, whitepaper matrices, and verifier registration. The audited gate_map folds those older ids into the current 8-bucket model so machine consumers do not have to reconcile two parallel Gate 1.0 taxonomies.

legacy_sources.description: Historical Gate 1.0 capability ids still registered in gate_test_framework.py for CLI and self-harness execution.
The Gate 1.0 technical whitepaper section 11.1 keeps the original 12 capability ids and flag names.
UPKG 1.1, M7.5 active runtime, upkg12_dopd_runtime_closure, and upkg120_edge_cloud_autonomy are the legacy naming surfaces that Gate 1.0 now consolidates.

notes: The historical id bundled real prefill production, auto-publish, and edge resume bridge into one operational flag.
The audited gate_map splits those concerns across the DOPD handoff bucket and the cloud runtime resume/decode bucket.
The historical dual-host topology id is no longer tracked as a standalone capability in the audited Gate 1.0 map.
It is now treated as part of the broader cloud foundation bucket that carries the deployment substrate.
Gate 1.0 no longer claims a standalone MoE route-consistency closure.
The remaining audited evidence is only the edge-side autonomy substrate around OMLX and FlashMoE execution entry.
The old State ABI id mixed transport contract, portable state layout, and DOPD resume payload semantics.
The audited map decomposes those concerns across CQ4 transport, TrueOrthoKDA portable state, and DOPD intermediate-state closure.
The old bootstrap id mixed runtime recovery path and governance bootstrap checks.
The audited map keeps runtime recovery under the cloud resume/decode bucket, while governance bootstrap and fail-fast policy stay under task_type and bundle governance.

capabilities.name: OMLX + FlashMoE memory threshold decision
capabilities.description: Edge-side memory and model-fit decision capability for autonomous local-vs-cloud routing.
notes: Edge capability surface is already implemented.
Host1 and Host2 both pass the real OMLX plus FlashMoE memory-threshold verifier.

capabilities.name: CQ4 edge-cloud protocol
capabilities.description: Protocol layer for carrying portable edge-cloud state and handoff semantics.
notes: Protocol capability exists and is already part of the runtime path.
Host1 and Host2 both pass the real CQ4 session plus transport-contract verifier.

capabilities.name: Zero-Copy VRAM handoff
capabilities.description: Zero-copy or minimal-copy resume path from transported state into device-side decode.
notes: Key runtime evidence already exists, including cpu_copy_count=0 and device_resume_consumed=true.

capabilities.name: TrueOrthoKDA KV + CQ4 compression
capabilities.description: Portable compressed KV/state representation for edge-cloud transport and resume.
notes: Formal runtime fields and state contract are already present.
Host1 and Host2 both build real KDA state, keep CQ4 compression ratio below 1.0, and complete zero-copy resume.

capabilities.name: DOPD Prefill/Decode decoupling
capabilities.description: Cloud-prefill and edge-decode decoupling with handoff prepare/commit/resume semantics.
notes: Control plane and data plane are connected.
Streaming and non-streaming auto-publish paths are already integrated.
Host1 and Host2 both pass the real prepare, commit, and resume verifier chain.

capabilities.name: SGLang + DeepEP TP4EP4 cloud foundation
capabilities.description: Cloud runtime foundation preserved as the prefill backbone while DOPD handoff is layered on top.
notes: The tp4ep4 prefill backbone is preserved.
This cloud foundation is formally accepted as part of the autonomy gate substrate.
Host1 and Host2 both pass the real TP4EP4 DeepEP builder verification and emit machine-consumable ep4_tp4 launch kwargs.

capabilities.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash cloud runtime resume/decode path
capabilities.description: Cloud-side runtime path for DOPD handoff, real prefill producer integration, and edge resume bridge.
notes: Runtime path is integrated.
Host1 and Host2 both pass GatewayRuntime.accept_resume_request with validated_and_resumed_edge ack status.

capabilities.name: task_type contract and bundle governance
capabilities.description: Static task_type contract plus four-stage bundle governance validation for runtime and audit consistency.
notes: Four-stage chain validation and fail-fast governance are already in place.
This forms the governance substrate for the autonomy gate.

edge_capability: Edge runtime can participate in autonomous routing.
state_transport: Transported state is formally encoded and recoverable.
Zero-copy or minimal-copy resume evidence exists.
edge_cloud_execution: Gateway auto-publish covers streaming and non-streaming paths.
Cloud tp4ep4 prefill backbone remains intact.
governance: task_type contract is a single source of truth.
Bundle chain can be validated fail-fast.
Review, verify, and audit commands can consume the same governance chain.

formally_claimable: Edge capability surface exists and participates in autonomy decisions.
Real cloud prefill producer is connected into DOPD handoff.
Gateway auto-publish and policy controls are integrated.
Edge resume from transported state is operational.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash cloud decode performance closure is accepted for Gate 1.0 wording.
Current codebase has validated full-pass evidence for m1-m7.6 and upkg21.
Cloud tp4ep4 prefill backbone is validated through real DeepEP builder output on both host1 and host2.
task_type contract and bundle governance chain are formally validated.
not_yet_formally_claimable: All cloud runtime scale scenarios are fully stability-qualified.
A pre-existing official UPKG 1.2 release-facing gate already exists.

validation_snapshot.summary: Current codebase has validated m1-m7.6 and upkg21 as all-green.
